verdictScope: the agreed first training task only; not a claim that every use case is ready

authoritativeDataset.name: examples-v3
authoritativeDataset.checksums: dataset/manifest.json sha256ByYear, 9 of 9 verified over the JSON lines; SHA256SUMS.txt over 19 files

initialTask.name: 20-session direction classification
initialTask.inputs: the `pit.f` block only: 15 price and volume derived features
initialTask.label: label20
initialTask.labelRule: fwd20 = close[t+20]/close[t] - 1; UP when fwd20 >= +2.0%, DOWN when <= -2.0%, else FLAT
initialTask.maturity: a session inside the final 20 of a series is excluded as immature, never labelled FLAT

PK.note: every absence classified: 36,762 no-trade sessions plus 158 empty archive dates

forex.warning: the fixed 2% band is not volatility-scaled and collapses 68% of FX into FLAT; FX direction classification is weakly supported by this label

diversityAndIndependence.outcomeWindowOverlap: consecutive rows for one instrument share 19 of their 20 forward sessions
diversityAndIndependence.effectiveNote: rows / 20. The row count is not the sample size for a 20-session label, and any confidence interval must use the effective figure

adverseRegimeCoverage.note: the bear periods are present and are the most DOWN-heavy years, so adverse conditions are represented rather than averaged away

pointInTimeAndLeakage.usrecExcluded: the NBER recession flag is ex-post and is excluded from the PIT feature set, with a test asserting its absence

splitPlan.why: one full label horizon, because a session's outcome window extends 20 sessions past it; without the embargo the last training rows and the first test rows share outcome sessions
splitPlan.notExecuted: no split was run and no model was evaluated in this milestone

dataQualityExclusions.howToUse: each flag is a column on the row, so a training run excludes them explicitly rather than hoping they were filtered upstream

4_featuresAndLabelsInTheDataset.features: pit.f, 15 price and volume derived fields

5_preservedButNotConsumed.macro: dataset/macro/macro-sessions.jsonl.gz ships inside the same bundle: 2,844 sessions, 31 series, each with value, publication age and change. Joinable on date; NOT pre-joined into the example rows
5_preservedButNotConsumed.pressAndEventLayers: preserved as separate artifacts; no example row carries an event or news field
5_preservedButNotConsumed.decision: not required for the first task, which is price-and-volume direction classification. Integrating them is a later capability milestone, not a gap in this one

A_marketStructureAndRegimes.trendAndMomentum: SUPPORTED (r1, r5, r20, sma20, sma50, returnZ)
A_marketStructureAndRegimes.breakoutsAndFailures: PARTIAL (entryTrigger and triggerDirection are null on ~90% of rows)
A_marketStructureAndRegimes.priceVolumeRelationship: SUPPORTED (volumeRatio); absent for FX, which publishes no volume
A_marketStructureAndRegimes.multipleTimeframes: NOT SUPPORTED (daily bars only; intraday is a 7-day rolling window, not history)

B_crossAssetAndMacro.macroReleasesAndRates: AVAILABLE NOT JOINED (macro-sessions.jsonl.gz, PIT-correct, joinable on date)
B_crossAssetAndMacro.pakistanSpecificPolicy: PARTIAL (SBP policy rate and KIBOR acquired; not a dataset feature)
B_crossAssetAndMacro.geopoliticalShocks: EVIDENCE ONLY (event corpus and reactions; not a dataset feature)
B_crossAssetAndMacro.regimeChange: NOT SUPPORTED as a label; no regime label exists

C_companyAndInstrumentEvents.earnings: EVIDENCE ONLY (86 verified earnings events, 13 official filings; not a dataset feature)
C_companyAndInstrumentEvents.corporateActions: PARTIAL (237 actions drive the unadjustedActionInWindow flag, which is a quality flag rather than a predictor)

D_newsAndCatalystInterpretation.classification: EVIDENCE ONLY (168 events categorised, 1,146 press references)
D_newsAndCatalystInterpretation.sourceReliability: PARTIAL (tier and evidence groups per event; no per-publisher statistics)
D_newsAndCatalystInterpretation.preAndPostEventBehaviour: SUPPORTED IN THE REACTION CORPUS (before / day0 / forward), not in examples-v3

E_outcomesAndRisk.benchmarkAdjusted: IN THE REACTION CORPUS ONLY (excess return vs ^GSPC); not in examples-v3
E_outcomesAndRisk.drawdownAndDuration: PARTIAL (mae is the adverse excursion; holding duration is fixed at 20 sessions)
E_outcomesAndRisk.stopAndTargetOrdering: NOT SUPPORTED (daily closes only; intraday path unknown)
E_outcomesAndRisk.executionCosts: NOT SUPPORTED (no observed spread, borrow or fee data for any market)

residualLimitations.measured: 62 of 127 S&P removals absent; 63 with no recoverable bars
residualLimitations.constrains: unbiased absolute-return claims; survivorship stays a measured lower bound
residualLimitations.doesNotConstrain: relative and directional research on the surviving universe

residualLimitations.measured: 68% of forex rows are FLAT under the fixed 2% band
residualLimitations.constrains: FX direction classification with this label
residualLimitations.doesNotConstrain: equity, crypto and commodity direction classification

residualLimitations.measured: 26 observations; ECB differs from the stored close by median 0.178%, max 2.09%
residualLimitations.constrains: nothing material (0.047% of FX bars); preserved as disputed with the ECB values

residualLimitations.measured: 717 bars, quarantined; upstream file itself incoherent
residualLimitations.constrains: range, ATR and pivot features on those rows
residualLimitations.doesNotConstrain: close-based features, which is what the first task uses

residualLimitations.measured: no free historical spread or borrow source for any market
residualLimitations.constrains: net-of-cost performance claims and PSX short-trade feasibility

residualLimitations.measured: 148 of 168 events with press references, 12 official-source-only, 2 searched-no-match, 6 source-limited, 0 pending
residualLimitations.constrains: news-driven features, which are not part of the first task

retentionSafety.evidence: retention.py references no foundation artifact; tests assert that, and that no collector writes into News

nextMilestone: Build the documented rule-based baseline and evaluate it chronologically with a 20-session embargo. No learned model, and no performance claim without out-of-sample evidence.
